# Naik Car Wash & Decors

Naik Car Wash & Decors is a two-location car care, detailing, paint-protection and car-accessories business serving Hanamkonda and Warangal, Telangana, India.

## Core services

- High-pressure foam wash, exterior care and underbody attention.
- Interior detailing, steam cleaning, dashboard conditioning and AC duct sanitization.
- Paint correction, ceramic or Teflon coating, paint protection and scratch attention.
- 3D wheel alignment, alloy wheels, custom seat covers, audio systems and styling accessories.

## Locations

### KUC X Road

Opp. Reliance Digital, KUC X Road, Hanamkonda, Warangal, Telangana 506009. Call +91 93476 76143. Maps: https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=Opp.+Reliance+Digital,+KUC+X+Road,+Hanamkonda,+Warangal,+Telangana+506009

### Fatima Junction

Fatima Junction, 100 Feet Rd, opp. Wadepally Lake, Hanamkonda, Telangana 506004. Call +91 73374 51268. Maps: https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=Fatima+Junction,+100+Feet+Road,+Hanamkonda,+Telangana+506004

## Business hours

Monday–Saturday: 8:00 AM–8:00 PM / 9:00 PM. Sunday: 8:00 AM–5:00 PM. Contact the selected branch to confirm appointment availability and the final recommended scope or price.

## Booking

Visitors can call a branch or submit the booking form, which prepares a WhatsApp message for the selected location. The website does not claim a confirmed appointment until a branch representative confirms it.
